basic_info.description: 2773-2777 Bryant is an excellently located three-unit property in two separate buildings in the vibrant Inner Mission neighborhood of San Francisco. There is a two story back cottage with three bedrooms and one bathroom, boasting ample storage and washer and dryer hookups on the lower level. The main building has two units both featuring three bedrooms, one bath, and back porch areas with washer and dryer hookups. These units have been upgraded to varying degrees, but both have charming period details, including crown molding, box beam ceilings, and Bay windows. All the units have hardwood floors, gas wall heaters, and separate hot water heaters/tanks. There is a  two car tandem garage currently occupied by the owner and one tenant. The garage will be delivered vacant at close of escrow. Separately metered for gas and electricity.
